checker_recommendation_for_the_board: Keep "one limiting speed" at PATH EXISTS (no move; recommendation only; one model family, checked once). Record the step "locking is confined to bound pieces" as NOT CLOSED, narrowed as follows. In a stand-in growth model where every unfired site can give birth and records are kept, locked links at bound pairs stay in small separate clusters at slow writing (w = 0.1) and join into one web at equal write and birth rates. With the growth-blocking lock, the web then stops growth. If a lock forbids Births from cutting it, the heir and either-newborn readings join even at slow writing. If a lock only stops its links shifting (the seat's recommended reading A), the heir reading stays separate to 32x and the either reading is borderline. If growth points are not renewed (one heir per pair, no new growth points), every newborn is eventually written and the locks join even at slow writing. Under PD-27 a growth-blocking lock on every written record allows no Births. For the light card's step L2: grown material as run has no link-sharing ring network, even under ring dynamics. Small locked pieces move gamma's side of the crossover by a few percent; the wave's side is not computed. Two step downgrades (S1, S4) as listed.
